description: The account's designs, newest first, each with its id (for get_mockup and create_order), name, garment, sides and approved (true = can be ordered). query finds one by name. Look here before creating a design: a new design starts unapproved. The client shows these pictures to the person: refer to each by its label, and never write a preview link as a markdown image. Give it as a plain link only if the person asks to open or download it, or can't see it, and do not generate, draw or edit your own version of the shirt, design or product.

garment.description: A garment code: GD64, CC17, LS14, or one stocked for this account alone (list_garments lists every one it can use)

limit.description: How many, newest first (default 20, at most 50).

query.description: Part of the design's name (or its id), case-insensitive.

status.description: approved: approved for printing; draft: not approved yet.

name: list_designs
title: List designs
